answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Dubbed meteorologist registration with weather service attestation stops them at the door: a registration the service renews after station audits, which means the saffron of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the juniper is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the beacon for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
